column1: # What the shipping server publishes, captured from a run of its own telemetry
# publisher against eclipse-mosquitto 2.1.2, not transcribed from its source.
# Columns: topic, payload, QoS, retain. {printerId} is substituted by the test;
# the job id is 42 and the tool is head 1. A payload of <unix-seconds> is a
# timestamp, checked for shape rather than for equality.
# The four data/tools/1/ rows are not from the capture. They replace its
# printer-wide material and nozzle rows and its data/slot/ rows, and they are
# what this adapter publishes for the tool tree (ADR-20261025-frz). Every other row is
# as the shipping server published it.
# The inputs that produced it are in publishOneOfEach, and re-capturing it means
# driving legacy/transport/mqtt.TelemetryPublisher with those same values.
# v1/server/online is not here: it is a lifecycle topic that belongs to the
# connection rather than to a printer, and it has tests of its own.
